steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Technology has always shaped media — from the printing press to broadcast radio to the internet. Each technological shift transforms how media is produced, distributed, and consumed.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Digital transformation: the shift from analogue to digital has affected every media form — digital cameras, non-linear editing, streaming, online publishing, and social media.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Convergence: smartphones combine multiple media forms (camera, music player, social media, web browser, TV). This has changed audience behaviour — we carry entire media libraries in our pockets.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Streaming revolution: Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+ have disrupted cinema, broadcast TV, and physical media. Content is available on demand, anywhere, on any device.
